summary.text: Stacey Hagen is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 111 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Cecelie Williams.
Hagen is a nurse and educator who, in a Ballotpedia survey, says she is running to bring honesty, integrity and transparency to state government.

paragraphs.text: Stacey Hagen graduated from Pattonville High School, earned an associate degree from St. Louis Community College, a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri, St. Louis in 2005, and a graduate degree from Regis University in 2012.
Her career experience includes working as a nurse.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Hagen described herself as a nurse and an educator who is not a politician.
Hagen listed three campaign messages in the survey: bringing honesty and integrity back to state government, funding public schools, and protecting access to quality, affordable health care.
She said her experience as a nurse showed her the consequences of people delaying health care because of cost.
